arms_schema: arms.<gating task>.cnn_pcg_only mirrors arms.<task>.<arm>.<clf> of the gating results.json: n, n_patients, majority (majority_class, accuracy, macro_f1, class_counts) and the metric entries in percent (accuracy, macro_f1, balanced_accuracy, sensitivity, specificity with *_ci; auroc, auprc in [0,1]; confusion_matrix; fold_macro_f1, fold_accuracy lists with _mean and _sd, population SD). Recording level; chunk_level holds the same entries at chunk level. Task names follow the gating notebook (detection = murmur).

split.recording_set: gating kept set: the 3000 recordings of the fold files, not the 3008 non-Unknown recordings of the original index

murmur.es_split: chunk-level 80/20 of pooled balanced-train + val chunks (original, not patient-disjoint)

test_chunk_counts.note: this run evaluates on the gating kept set (and on the DRY_RUN / LIMIT subset when active); the published counts come from the full non-Unknown set
